messages:
maya: quick heads-up — planning engine kernel bump + new quant profile push for +/- 2% perf on text-gen. Target window: Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC. Who can own deploy and smoke? I'll be on-call but need a deploy owner. @tj? :wave:

tj: I can own deploy slot, +I'll handle rollback if needed. What's the canary slice size?

maya: thanks. plan: 5% canary for 20 min, then 25% for 15 min, full by 30m if green. Canary pods get new kernel + quant-v2. Need smoke checks: 1) 99th p99 latency on sample prompt < 350ms, 2) output quality quick eval on 50 prompts, 3) kv-cache hit sanity. Commands I usually run:

maya: ```
# smoke curl
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-engine-v2","prompt":"Hello"}' | jq .

# tail logs
kubectl -n runtime logs deploy/rwd-engine-v2 -f --tail=200
```

sam: I reviewed the quant PR — noted a fallback path in code but missing metric emit on quant-fallback. I'll add a tiny patch now. also: ensure eval set is the one in /evals/runtime/quick_checks.json

alicia: ops question — if kv-cache migration fails, what's exact rollback? image revert or feature flag? We should prefer image revert + kv-cache clear? :thinking:

tj: rollback plan: revert deployment image to rwd-engine-v1.9, run a rolling restart, and set quant-profile back to quant-v1 in configmap. kv-cache clearing only if we see stale state; otherwise keep it.

maya: agree. add to runbook: steps + exact kubectl commands. Also need observability owner to thumbs-up before promoting — @sam will you watch traces/ratios?

sam: on it. I'll watch tail-samples, trace-sample and hit the eval set every 5 minutes. If quality regression > 1.5% we abort and rollback. :no_entry_sign:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by @tj for 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z — canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. See https://deploys.redwood/rollouts/2290123456

ops-bot: Reminder: notify support team 30m before full promotion. @alicia please confirm.

alicia: confirmed, pinging support now. I also added a quick FAQ snippet for CS on possible errors.

tj: quick QA: who has credentials for the private smoke account? I need the token to run the eval script.

maya: I uploaded a burner token to the secure creds vault, path: secrets/runtime/smoke-token. tj, I gave you access.

sam: small nit — canary logs show a WARN about attention-cache mismatch on startup in the PR logs. Not fatal but worth keeping an eye.

maya: noted. we'll watch. after canary completes I'll open a short postmortem if anything odd.

tj: ready on my side. I'll start the canary at the window. tagging this thread so anyone jumping in later can see plan.

maya: thanks all — will join 03:15 UTC for first sweep. :rocket:
